definitions.full: H137. Adoni -bezeq אֲדֹנִיבֶֿ֫זֶק proper name, masculine (or title) king of Canaanite city Bezek Judg 1:7 ; without Maqqeph 1:5 ; 1:6 . **Read probably קּצֶ֫דֶק׳א , see GFM 1:5 .

occurrences.englishText: They found Adoni-Bezek in Bezek, and they fought against him. They struck the Canaanites and the Perizzites.
But Adoni-Bezek fled. They pursued him, caught him, and cut off his thumbs and his big toes.

Adoni-Bezek said, “Seventy kings, having their thumbs and their big toes cut off, scavenged under my table. As I have done, so God‡ The Hebrew word rendered “God” is “אֱלֹהִ֑ים” (Elohim). has done to me.” They brought him to Jerusalem, and he died there.
